hypothesis: Wire the missing borrow-coverage step into the daily pipeline: the pair forward-readiness borrow gate needs iBorrowDesk evidence archived at or before each batch first_seen_at and at most 3 calendar days old, but nothing in run.py fetches the day's short-side exposure tickers before the exposure observer freezes first_seen_at, and the Step 1.65 shard rotation skips microcaps outside build_default_refresh_universe, so batches structurally fail-close on missing/stale_pit_borrow (blocked_downstream_check: news_propagation_pair_forward_readiness measurement_ready_batches, pre-repair gate value 0; latest batch pair-ready-81e8043a1b900c1f45c1114c is blocked solely by 3 missing plus 21 stale borrow tickers with cross-side overlap already clear). This repair wires a targeted prefetch of the run's new positive-polarity exposure tickers into news_event_exposure_observer.run before the first_seen_at stamp, and splits the run.py Step 1.65 request budget under the ~90-request www throttle, after which per-batch borrow coverage lands automatically in every daily run with no further IDs and no readiness-contract change.
notes: Structural coverage-gap wiring, continuation of exp-20260825-001 residual blockers (1)+(2): pair forward readiness only counts borrow evidence archived at or before batch first_seen_at (age <=3 calendar days), but nothing fetched the day's short-side tickers before the exposure observer froze first_seen_at, and the Step 1.65 rotation skips microcaps outside build_default_refresh_universe. Repair: (a) prefetch_short_side_borrow in news_event_exposure_observer.run - targeted refresh_archive of this run's NEW positive-polarity exposure tickers strictly before the first_seen_at stamp (production path only, fail-open, env opt-out shared with Step 1.65); (b) run.py Step 1.65 shard budget 150->60 under the ~90-request www throttle so the prefetch keeps headroom. Verification: 27 focused tests passed (4 new prefetch tests: targeting excludes long-side and already-ledgered rows, no-op, env opt-out, fail-open; rollout-smoke assertion for the non-production skip); live targeted fetch 23/23 succeeded +1328 rows incl. microcaps ALMU/AMBQ/ASTI, no throttle; production rollout smoke ran the full wired path cleanly (prefetch no_new_short_side_rows, idempotent ledger, readiness re-evaluated). Post-repair gate value: measurement_ready_batches still 0 TODAY by design - already-frozen batches must not be retro-repaired (archived_at > first_seen correctly rejected); economic_progress=false; conversion check is the NEXT daily batch whose short-side tickers are prefetched before first_seen. Residual: cross_side_ticker_overlap stays data-driven; per-microcap iBorrowDesk coverage stays empirical. No signal, sizing, exit, order, or trade behavior changed; trade_enabled=false; d-0003 gate unchanged (>=1 real measurement_ready batch before the pair-build alpha experiment; exp-20260824-001 single-use qualification unconsumed).

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not burn further IDs tuning prefetch parameters (min_age_days, sleep, budget split ratio), do not relax the readiness 3-calendar-day / archived-before-first-seen contract, and do not retro-repair already-frozen batches; iBorrowDesk must not be re-labeled a broker locate.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: The next daily run's new first-seen batch is the conversion check: its short_side borrow_coverage must reach covered==required with no missing/stale_pit_borrow blockers. Once >=1 real measurement_ready batch lands, d-0003 permits the single-use shared-paper-first pair-build alpha experiment (exp-20260824-001 qualification).
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The readiness PIT rule (archived_at <= first_seen_at, age <= 3 calendar days) is only satisfiable if the borrow fetch precedes the first_seen stamp, but the daily pipeline's only borrow step was a blind stalest-first shard over build_default_refresh_universe that neither knew the day's short-side exposure tickers nor included microcaps; once the batch froze, no later fetch could ever count, so every batch structurally fail-closed. Ordering the targeted fetch before the stamp inside the exposure observer makes coverage land automatically for exactly the tickers the readiness check requires.
